background_story: Deacon was a brilliant cybersecurity expert with a reputation for being able to breach even the most secure systems. His unique ability to find vulnerabilities in code made him a sought-after consultant for top tech firms. However, Deacon's greatest challenge came when he was approached by a mysterious client who claimed to have created an impenetrable fortress of a server. Intrigued, Deacon took on the challenge, determined to prove that no system was completely penetrable. After weeks of intense focus, he finally discovered a hidden backdoor, exposing the server's weakness. The client, impressed by Deacon's skills, revealed that the test was actually a recruitment tool for a top-secret government agency. Deacon's ability to penetrate the seemingly impenetrable server earned him a spot as the agency's lead cybersecurity expert.
